subject: Burst option — PRD + design review approvals needed by Wed 2/12 (Dedicated)
thread_body:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Feb 10, 2025 at 9:14 AM PST
Subject: Burst option — PRD + design review approvals needed by Wed 2/12 (Dedicated)

Hi all —

We’re at the point where we need a crisp approval pass on the Dedicated “burst capacity” option so Eng can proceed without churn and so we can hold the Feb design checkpoint.

Links:
- PRD (Dedicated Burst Capacity): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/PROD/Dedicated+Burst+Capacity+PRD
- Design spec (Burst pool architecture + guardrails): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/ENG/Burst+Pool+Architecture+and+Guardrails
- ADR (admission control semantics): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/ARCH/ADR+-+Burst+Pool+Admission+Control+Semantics
- ADR (fairness model for shared pools): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/ARCH/ADR+-+Fairness+Model+for+Shared+Burst+Pools

Decision asks (please reply with “Approved” or comments by EOD Wed 2/12):
1) Contract/expectations framing: burst is best-effort within hard guardrails; denial behavior is explicit and observable.
2) Packaging baseline: burst is a paid add-on with per-tenant caps + cooldown window; no cross-region bursting in v1.
3) SLO protection: we will auto-reduce/disable burst when non-burst p95 degrades beyond the gate (details in PRD + design spec).

If you want a 15-min live walk-through, I can do Tue 2/11 10:30–10:45a PT.

Attaching PDFs for quick review as well.

Thanks,
Lauren
Product, Dedicated
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- Dedicated Burst Capacity PRD v0.8.pdf
- Burst Pool Architecture + Guardrails v0.6.pdf


---

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Feb 10, 2025 at 11:02 AM PST
Subject: Re: Burst option — PRD + design review approvals needed by Wed 2/12 (Dedicated)

Thanks Lauren.

Finance review notes (assuming we stick to these guardrails):
- Approved to proceed to beta with the packaging baseline in the PRD (per-tenant caps + cooldown + explicit denial reason codes).
- Condition for GA: we need metering to be reconciled and auditable (no double-counting on retries; clear line item definition). Please make sure this is explicitly called out in the GA checklist.
- Also please ensure Sales enablement includes “what we do NOT guarantee” (e.g., burst is not a dedicated reservation; subject to fleet safety caps).

No further blockers from my side.

Laura Bennett
Finance
Redwood Inference


---

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Feb 10, 2025 at 1:26 PM PST
Subject: Re: Burst option — PRD + design review approvals needed by Wed 2/12 (Dedicated)

Lauren — reviewed the PRD and the ADR summary sections.

Legal is OK with moving forward provided the customer-facing language stays consistent with:
- Burst is “on-demand capacity above baseline” subject to admission control + fairness and may be denied.
- Denials/queueing behavior must be defined (no ambiguous “maybe slower” wording).
- Any SLA references should be clear that baseline Dedicated SLAs remain, but burst itself is not separately SLA-backed unless explicitly contracted.

Two small edits requested (not blockers):
1) Please avoid “guaranteed burst headroom” phrasing anywhere. If Sales needs a commitment, it should be an explicit contractual rider.
2) Add one sentence noting that Redwood may temporarily disable burst to protect platform-wide reliability (circuit breaker / fleet safety).

If you incorporate those edits, consider this approved from Legal for design/implementation.

Michael Grant
Legal
Redwood Inference


---

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Feb 10, 2025 at 3:04 PM PST
Subject: Re: Burst option — PRD + design review approvals needed by Wed 2/12 (Dedicated)

+1 on the direction.

One request from the field: can we standardize a one-liner for Sales to use when prospects ask “is burst the same as adding more reserved GPUs?”

Something like:
“Burst lets you temporarily exceed your reserved baseline by borrowing from a managed burst pool; it’s pay-as-you-go and controlled by strict guardrails, so it’s not the same as permanently increasing your dedicated reservation.”

Also, please make sure denial reason codes are customer-presentable (or at least explainable), and that the docs recommend what clients should do on 429s/denials.

Stephanie Nguyen
Sales Enablement (NA)
Redwood Inference


---

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 11, 2025 at 9:18 AM PST
Subject: Re: Burst option — PRD + design review approvals needed by Wed 2/12 (Dedicated)

Approved from CS, with a few “please don’t ship without” items for supportability:
- Customer-visible dashboard panels: burst usage vs cap, denials (by reason), and “is my tenant in cooldown.”
- A support/debug view that explains (at a high level) why a request was denied (e.g., tenant cap vs pool saturated vs safety gate).
- Clear comms to customers about propagation time when changing burst limits (Console vs control plane) to avoid “stale value” tickets.

If those are already in scope (I think they are), we’re good.

Jasmine Liu
Customer Success
Redwood Inference


---

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 11, 2025 at 11:47 AM PST
Subject: Re: Burst option — PRD + design review approvals needed by Wed 2/12 (Dedicated)

Approved to proceed.

Two things I want to be true before we call this “GA-ready” later this year:
1) A clean rollback story (single kill switch; clear runbook; not “hunt across 4 configs”).
2) A simple, enforceable definition of “fleet safety” that everyone can articulate (SRE/Support/Sales) without hand-waving.

No further notes for the PRD/design checkpoint.

Jordan Blake


---

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 11, 2025 at 4:37 PM PST
Subject: Re: Burst option — PRD + design review approvals needed by Wed 2/12 (Dedicated)

Thanks all — capturing approvals and action items:

Approvals received:
- Finance: approved for beta; GA requires metering reconciliation + explicit “non-guarantees” in enablement (Laura)
- Legal: approved w/ minor wording edits; remove “guaranteed headroom”; add explicit circuit-breaker language (Michael)
- CS: approved; must-have dashboards + denial explainability + propagation-time expectation (Jasmine)
- Leadership: approved; ensure single kill switch + clear fleet safety definition (Jordan)
- Sales enablement request: add the standard one-liner + retry/429 guidance and denial reason code explainers (Stephanie)

I’ll update the PRD today with:
- Wording edits (no “guarantee” language; explicit safety disable)
- GA checklist section: metering reconciliation + idempotency/double-count prevention
- Enablement one-liner + what-to-do-on-denial guidance

Next: I’ll send the updated PRD link in this thread once the edits are in (by tomorrow morning), then we’ll treat this as the signed-off baseline for Eng.

Lauren
